create_geometry_config: create a GeometryConfig pydantic model with a discriminated union of circular, chease, fbt, eqdsk, or imas geometry configs
build_geometry_from_dict: build a Geometry pydantic model from a user config dict specifying geometry_type and geometry parameters
build_geometry_provider: build a geometry provider from a Geometry instance, returning constant or time-dependent provider based on geometry type
get_face_centers: get the face centers of the geometry as a numpy array from a Geometry instance
conform_user_data: conform a user geometry config dict to the internal pydantic model structure, handling time-dependent and single geometry configs
